draft.shortGloss: to put; to place; to wear
draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and direct, organizing things in their proper place
notes: Mettere is one of the most common verbs in Italian, used for physical placement, putting on clothes, and turning on appliances.
Do not confuse with 'portare', which means to carry or bring.
